posts.content:
What if you could press pause on the city for 30 days every year?

Not a vacation. Not a getaway.

A reset.

The 10% Lifestyle gives you 30 nights across all Beforest collectives - Coorg, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bhopal.

Same dates every year. For 10 years.

Your children will grow up knowing what silence sounds like.

30 nights. 10 years. Rs. 17.6 lakhs.

Founding member applications open.

Let's talk numbers.

A 5-star resort in Coorg: Rs. 25,000/night
30 nights/year x 10 years = Rs. 75 lakhs

The 10% Lifestyle: Rs. 17.6 lakhs

Same nights. Same locations.
But you own the asset.

Plus: Your kids learn where coffee comes from.
Plus: You join 50+ conservation-minded families.
Plus: Zero electricity homes. Perennial streams. 150+ bird species.

The math isn't even close.

Founding circle closes soon.

"I came for the land. I stayed for the people."

- Priya K., Mumbai

The 10% Lifestyle isn't just about 30 nights in the Western Ghats.

It's about who you meet there.

Entrepreneurs who've stepped off the treadmill.
Artists seeking silence.
Families who believe their children should know what frogs sound like at night.

50+ families. 10 years. One shared vision.

Founding member spots: 12 remaining.

The Western Ghats are one of 10 biodiversity hotspots on Earth.

Not in India.
On Earth.

The 10% Lifestyle gives you 30 nights annually in the Pushpagiri ranges:

→ 150+ bird species
→ Big cats (yes, really)
→ Small-clawed otters
→ 50% of the land preserved as forest

This isn't a resort.
It's a wildlife corridor that happens to have your room in it.

Rs. 17.6 lakhs. 30 nights/year. 10 years.

Applications open.

"But I don't have 30 days to take off."

Fair.

But what if those 30 days weren't "time off"?

What if they were:
→ Strategic planning without Slack notifications
→ Deep work without urban noise
→ Family time that doesn't involve screens
→ The space to remember why you started

The 10% Lifestyle isn't about escaping work.
It's about doing better work.

30 nights. 10 years. Rs. 17.6 lakhs.

5:47 AM. Malabar whistling thrush.

Not an alarm. A bird.

You make coffee. The beans were grown 200 meters from your room.

After breakfast: a walk. You see fresh leopard tracks near the stream.

Lunch is with other members. Someone just sold their company. Someone else is writing a novel. Nobody asks "what do you do?"

Afternoon: nap in a hammock.
Evening: dinner under stars you forgot existed.

This is one day of 30 you'll get every year.

The 10% Lifestyle. Rs. 17.6 lakhs. 10 years.

We're not building villas.

We're building homes that disappear into the landscape.

Zero electricity for heating.
Gravity-fed water.
Materials from within 50km.

Each 10% Lifestyle home takes 18 months to complete.
Not because we're slow.
Because we're careful.

Your 30 nights/year include access to:
→ All collectives (Coorg, Hyd, Mumbai, Bhopal)
→ Shared kitchens and gathering spaces
→ The 50% of land we keep wild

Founding members get priority site selection.

12 spots remaining.

The 10% Lifestyle founding circle:

Not marketing. Math.

We have room for 12 families in the first cohort.

Why 12?
Because 12 people can know each other well.
Because 12 families can make decisions together.
Because 12 is enough to start something.

We have 50+ inquiries.

Selection isn't first-come-first-served.
It's fit-based.
Values-aligned.
Long-term thinking.

Rs. 17.6 lakhs. 30 nights/year. 10 years.

Application closes when 12 are selected.

"What exactly is the 10% Lifestyle?"

Simple:

→ 30 nights per year across all Beforest collectives
→ Same dates annually for 10 years
→ Access to Coorg, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bhopal locations
→ Fully managed hospitality experience
→ Community of 50+ conservation-minded families
→ Zero-electricity homes in biodiversity hotspots

The cost: Rs. 17.6 lakhs

The catch: 12 founding spots only.

This isn't timeshare.
This isn't fractional ownership.

This is access to something that doesn't really exist yet.

Interested? Link in comments.

When was the last time you heard complete silence?

Not quiet.
Silence.

The kind where you can hear your own thoughts.

The 10% Lifestyle gives you 30 nights of it every year.

In the Western Ghats.
In a home that uses zero electricity.
Among people who also came to listen.

Rs. 17.6 lakhs.
30 nights per year.
10 years.

The founding circle is forming now.

12 spots.

What's silence worth to you?
